title: Zebra closes a remotely triggerable crash
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
ORGANIZATIONS
02
Zebra closes a remotely triggerable crash
Security release · September 25
ZCASH FOUNDATION
 ZEBRA 6.4.2
01
Update from 6.4.0 or 6.4.1
Version 6.4.2 fixes denial of service from malformed V6 transactions. The affected
releases were withdrawn.
02
Experimental light-client serving
The 6.4 release line adds experimental gRPC serving for light clients, alongside
node synchronization and monitoring improvements.
03
NU7 preparation continues
The September scope agreement targets shorter blocks and NSM integration.
Activation remains a later event.
04
Checks restored before release
September reviews caught validation regressions on the development branch.
Those omissions never shipped.

title: Crosslink prepares its next feature network
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
ORGANIZATIONS
03
Crosslink prepares its next feature network
Engineering and organization updates · September 17-28
SHIELDED LABS
RESEARCH + IMPLEMENTATION
01
Nightly network deployed
The team reported a first nightly network for testing consensus changes and
collecting participant feedback.
02
Ironwood code integrated
The Crosslink branch incorporated Zebra 6.2.3-era changes while staking logic
and documentation were refined.
03
Round 3 transition planned
A September 28 announcement schedules an October 1 workshop for the next
network. Crosslink remains experimental.
04
Execution support expanded
Steven Smith joined as an advisor on September 24, supporting Crosslink planning,
documentation and ZIP work.

title: Recursive proofs gain shared foundations
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
ORGANIZATIONS
04
Recursive proofs gain shared foundations
Technical publications · September 28-29
PROJECT TACHYON
PROPOSED SCALING UPGRADE
01
Udon joins Zakura Common
New crates begin moving Ragu components into the shared proving stack,
reducing duplicated infrastructure.
02
Reusable proof history
A new design explains how shared epoch evidence can support wallet checks
without keeping all history at validators.
03
Path to deployment
Mainnet activation remains subject to further engineering work, review and
community agreement.

title: Faster nodes prepare Zcash for NU7
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
ORGANIZATIONS
05
Faster nodes prepare Zcash for NU7
September releases and team-reported tests
ZAKURA
V1.6.0 / SEP 30 BRT
01
25-second stressnet
80 nodes across 11 regions measured 3.43% orphan blocks with full 2 MB blocks.
A stress test, not Mainnet performance.
02
Faster block verification
The team reports 8x faster average and 17x faster full-block verification after
September optimizations.
03
Common: speed and formal analysis
Team tests show 21x faster iPhone 17 proving. Lean verifies zero knowledge for a
model of the optimized prover.
04
NU7-ready release
v1.6.0 sets Testnet height 4,465,026, uses Common 2.2.0 and lowers node fee
policy to 400 zatoshis per action.

title: Shielded Ledger payments reach desktop
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
HARDWARE
07
Shielded Ledger payments reach desktop
Released September 23 · Device and wallet requirements matter
Ledger Wallet 4.21+
Private send and receive, memos, shielding and unshielding
shipped on desktop.
Zcash app 3.9.4+
The device app supports Ironwood. Sapling and Orchard
funds do not appear in this integration.
Independent wallet integration
Zkool added official Ledger account import and signing; Vizor
updated Ledger and Keystone handling.
Zakura's Ledger contribution
Open PR #42 measured review-screen preparation at 10.17s
to ~5.50s on Flex. Not yet merged or released.

title: The supporting stack becomes easier to build on
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
INFRASTRUCTURE
08
The supporting stack becomes easier to build on
Released software and explicitly dated engineering updates
Zaino 0.10.1 · Sep 29
Indexed-tip notifications, service health checks and graceful
shutdown improve indexer operations.
Zecd 0.8.0 · Sep 22
A Rust library interface, sync improvements and SOCKS
support broaden wallet-service integration.
Zallet · Sep 3 update
The team reported Beta 3 migration fixes and a second audit
review round, with further beta work in progress.
QEDIT + Nym · Sep 17
ZSA work moves onto NU6.3; Nym reported published
transport modules. Integration progress does not imply ZSA
activation.

title: Products expand wallet and application choices
text:
OPENZCASH
MONTHLY
PRODUCTS
09
Products expand wallet and application choices
Builder announcements · Production, prototype and testnet are distinct
Zucchini 0.5.2
The September 28 release adds website permissions,
payment requests and developer SDKs.
Konclave 0.8.0
September 30 fixes address a change-verification fault. The
team advises desktop users to update.
Noir Protocol
Introduced September 29 as a multi-token and DeFi design
around ZEC. An announcement, not a Zcash protocol
activation.
Skyhook beta
September 30 demonstration links Sepolia ETH and testnet
TAZ. It is not a production ETH-ZEC bridge.
